articles.title: FDA Knew Its COVID Vaccine Safety System Was Broken — Then Buried the Whistleblower Who Said So
articles.summary: Internal emails from New York's medical examiner office reveal FDA officials privately acknowledged flaws in vaccine safety surveillance while publicly insisting the shots were safe. A 16-year-old died four days after his second Pfizer dose with cardiac abnormalities consistent with vaccine injury — and the system designed to catch it failed by design. The whistleblower who raised alarms was suppressed, not elevated.

articles.title: Pharma Whistleblower: Madrigal Pushed Out Its Own Clinical Chief After He Flagged Liver Injury Data on FDA-Approved Drug Rezdiffra
articles.summary: Former clinical chief Michael Charlton alleges Madrigal Pharmaceuticals retaliated against him after he raised internal concerns about liver-injury signals tied to Rezdiffra — a drug the FDA approved anyway. The lawsuit exposes the classic pharma playbook: silence the insider, ship the product, let regulators rubberstamp the rest. If the clinical chief can't speak freely, no one inside can.

articles.title: Biden White House and Pfizer Colluded to Kill Cheap COVID Treatment While Profiting from Patented Pill, Persecuted Doctor Alleges
articles.summary: A physician who promoted an effective, low-cost COVID treatment claims the Biden administration coordinated with Pfizer to suppress it — clearing the market for Paxlovid, a patented alternative that generated billions. The doctor faced professional retaliation for speaking out, a pattern repeated across dozens of clinicians during the pandemic. This is what regulatory capture looks like when it has a body count.

articles.title: Vaccine Mandates Broke People — Canada's Healthcare Workers Describe the Moral Wreckage Left Behind
articles.summary: Canadian healthcare professionals who refused COVID vaccine mandates describe job loss, psychological trauma, and what researchers are now calling moral injury — the damage done when institutions force individuals to act against their conscience under threat of livelihood. These are not fringe cases; they are a documented public health cost that official bodies refuse to account for. The human wreckage of coercive policy is being quietly erased from the record.

articles.title: Epidemiologist Hulscher Names mRNA Shots as the Deadliest Product in History — Mainstream Science Won't Touch It
articles.summary: McCullough Foundation epidemiologist Nicolas Hulscher lays out a systematic case — drawing on excess mortality data, VAERS signals, and flu vaccine efficacy fraud — that mRNA COVID shots represent an unprecedented safety catastrophe. He also examines suppressed metabolic and natural approaches to cancer that the oncology establishment refuses to investigate. This is the conversation peer review won't host.

articles.title: The Miracle Vitamin Medical Consensus Has Refused to Re-Examine for Decades
articles.summary: Researcher Jeff T. Bowles argues that official dosing guidelines for a widely available vitamin are not just wrong but dangerously low — and that the medical establishment has systematically avoided revisiting the evidence. The suppression isn't dramatic; it's bureaucratic inertia protecting a paradigm that makes cheap interventions invisible. When the answer costs nothing, no one funds the trial.

articles.title: Urolithin A and Mitochondrial Renewal: The Longevity Science Big Pharma Has No Patent Interest In
articles.summary: Emerging research on Urolithin A — a compound derived from gut metabolism of polyphenols — shows meaningful support for mitochondrial autophagy in aging immune cells, a pathway implicated in inflammation, energy decline, and immune senescence. This research is funded outside the pharma pipeline precisely because it cannot be patented at scale. The establishment's silence on mitochondrial renewal science is proportional to its unprofitability.

articles.title: Brownstone's Kheriaty: Sex Differences in Psychiatry Are Real — and the Field Has Been Lying About Them
articles.summary: Dr. Aaron Kheriaty examines how biological sex differences in medicine and psychiatry have been systematically downplayed or ideologically suppressed, distorting clinical outcomes for both men and women. Drug trials historically designed around male physiology, then applied universally, have produced documented harms that regulators minimized. The convergence of political pressure and pharmaceutical convenience has made honest sex-stratified science nearly impossible to publish.

articles.title: Blood Clots and Buried Science: What the Medical Establishment Refused to Tell You
articles.summary: Brownstone Institute's Joseph Varon dissects how common-sense warnings about blood clot risks were systematically ignored or suppressed during the COVID era. The piece names institutional failures that left patients uninformed and unprotected. When clinical reality contradicts approved narrative, it is patients who pay the price in blood.

articles.title: Why Weren't We Warned? The Institutional Silence That Killed Informed Consent
articles.summary: Alan Cassels at Brownstone Institute confronts the deliberate failure of public health authorities to warn the public about known medical risks — a pattern of omission that constitutes a fundamental breach of informed consent. The piece challenges why regulators and media suppressed safety signals that were visible to independent researchers. This is not incompetence; it is a policy of silence.

articles.title: Vaccinating Surgical Patients: The Ethical Atrocity Being Normalized in Hospital Wards
articles.summary: Clayton J. Baker, MD, tears apart the practice of 'perioperative vaccination' — administering vaccines to patients in the perioperative window when immune systems are compromised and informed consent is most vulnerable. Baker argues this practice violates foundational medical ethics and exposes patients to compounded risks that are never disclosed. The fact that this is being normalized without outcry from medical boards is itself the scandal.

articles.title: Vitamin D Research the Mainstream Won't Amplify: What the 2024 International Forum Actually Found
articles.summary: Mercola.com covers the 2024 International Virtual Vitamin D Forum, presenting peer-reviewed evidence on vitamin D's systemic role in immune function, disease prevention, and overall health — research that receives a fraction of the funding and media attention lavished on patentable pharmaceuticals. The suppression of low-cost nutritional interventions in favor of high-margin drugs is not accidental. Follow the money.

articles.title: Texas Children's Hospital Forced to Open Detransition Clinic After $10M Settlement — The Medical Scandal They Hoped Would Stay Quiet
articles.summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton's historic settlement with Texas Children's Hospital has compelled the institution to open the first-of-its-kind detransition clinic, serving patients harmed by gender transition interventions the hospital performed on minors. The $10 million penalty and clinic requirement are a direct indictment of a medical establishment that performed irreversible procedures while suppressing detransitioner outcomes data. This is what accountability looks like when regulators finally act.

articles.title: ENO2-Driven Glycolysis in Liver Cancer: Metabolic Research That Challenges the Standard Oncology Playbook
articles.summary: New research published in PLOS ONE identifies ENO2-driven glycolytic metabolism as a key driver of hepatocellular carcinoma progression, lending further weight to metabolic theories of cancer that have long been sidelined by the oncology establishment in favor of genetic mutation frameworks. The study maps ENO2's prognostic relevance and functional role, opening therapeutic angles that go beyond conventional chemotherapy targets. Warburg-era metabolic science keeps being vindicated — and keeps being ignored.

articles.title: PICU Beds Vanishing Nationwide as Medicaid Cuts Gut Critical Pediatric Care
articles.summary: KFF Health News documents the accelerating closure of pediatric intensive care units across the country, driven directly by federal Medicaid funding cuts that have left rural and low-income children without access to critical care infrastructure. Pediatricians on the ground are sounding alarms that are going unheard in Washington. This is what happens when health policy is driven by budget politics rather than patient outcomes — and the most vulnerable children absorb the damage.

articles.title: Pandemic Preparedness Without Accountability Is Just Power — Ramesh Thakur Calls It Out
articles.summary: Ramesh Thakur at Brownstone Institute dissects the 'equity' framing being embedded into pandemic preparedness frameworks, arguing it serves as cover for centralized power grabs that remove accountability from the institutions most responsible for COVID-era failures. The WHO and national health bureaucracies that got it catastrophically wrong are now being handed more authority under the guise of equity. Justice without accountability is not equity — it is impunity rebranded.

articles.title: Fauci Was Wrong About 'Almost Every Single Pandemic Policy': Former FDA Insider Breaks Silence
articles.summary: Vinay Prasad, a former FDA insider turned outspoken critic, tells Reason magazine that Anthony Fauci was wrong about nearly every major COVID-19 policy he championed — from lockdowns to masking to school closures. This comes as public health institutions hemorrhage credibility and face unprecedented scrutiny over pandemic-era decision-making. Prasad's indictment is specific, credentialed, and damning — exactly the kind of dissent that was systematically silenced during the pandemic.

articles.title: Brownstone Institute Asks the Question No One in Public Health Will Answer: Why Weren't We Warned?
articles.summary: A new Brownstone Institute investigation confronts the institutional failure to communicate honest risk-benefit analyses to the public during the COVID era — a silence that cost lives and destroyed trust. The piece forces a reckoning with how health authorities weaponized selective disclosure, withholding data that contradicted the approved narrative. The question of who knew what and when remains unanswered by the agencies that owe the public accountability.

articles.title: Political Meddling in Medicine Is Destroying Your Health Freedom — And the Data Proves It
articles.summary: Mercola.com republishes a landmark analysis documenting how political interference in hospital systems and health institutions during the COVID-19 pandemic eroded public trust and medical autonomy. The piece catalogs how approved narratives were enforced while dissenting physicians faced professional retaliation and censorship. Trust in hospitals has collapsed — not because of misinformation, but because the institutions themselves abandoned scientific integrity.

articles.title: Vitamin D Research the Mainstream Won't Touch: International Forum Exposes What the Guidelines Are Hiding
articles.summary: The 2024 International Virtual Vitamin D Forum presented evidence on vitamin D's broad systemic roles — from immune modulation to disease prevention — that continues to be dismissed or underfunded by establishment bodies like the NIH. Despite mounting peer-reviewed evidence, official dietary guidelines have refused to meaningfully update their recommendations, leaving the public underinformed and under-supplemented. This is nutrition science suppression playing out in real time.

articles.title: Longevity Science Has a Women Problem — And the Influencer Industrial Complex Is Making It Worse
articles.summary: Physicians are raising alarms that popular longevity protocols — from prolonged fasting to aggressive supplementation regimens — were designed exclusively around male physiology and are being uncritically promoted to women without evidence of safety or efficacy. The longevity space, largely funded outside traditional research structures, has outrun the science and is now actively ignoring sex-based biological differences that could cause real harm. This is what happens when independent research operates without accountability.

articles.title: Texas Forces Children's Hospital to Open Detransition Clinic After $10M Settlement — The Medical Establishment Is Furious
articles.summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton's historic legal settlement with Texas Children's Hospital has compelled the institution to open the first detransition clinic in the country, serving patients seeking care after gender-transition interventions — a patient population that mainstream medicine has actively refused to acknowledge or study. The $10 million penalty and mandated clinic represent a legal forcing function against an institution that suppressed clinical outcomes data on pediatric transition. Detransitioners finally have a facility; the establishment has no answer for why it took a lawsuit to create it.

articles.title: ENO2-Driven Glycolysis in Liver Cancer: Metabolic Research the Oncology Mainstream Keeps Sidelining
articles.summary: New peer-reviewed research in PLOS ONE identifies ENO2-driven glycolytic reprogramming as a key driver of hepatocellular carcinoma progression — directly implicating tumor metabolism in cancer development in ways that challenge the dominant gene-mutation-centric model. This metabolic theory of cancer aligns with suppressed research traditions that trace malignancy to mitochondrial dysfunction rather than purely genetic causes. The oncology establishment's continued neglect of metabolic mechanisms delays treatment innovation and costs lives.

articles.title: Theranos 2.0? Elizabeth Holmes' Partner Is Running a Blood-Testing Startup With No Product and Big Promises
articles.summary: Fortune reports that Billy Evans, partner of convicted Theranos fraudster Elizabeth Holmes, is operating a blood-testing startup called Haemanthus — complete with patents, investors, and a mysteriously absent CTO — but no actual product. The parallels to Theranos are not subtle: a charismatic founder, proprietary health tech claims, and a conspicuous absence of independent validation. The FDA's failure to proactively scrutinize this operation, given the documented history, raises serious questions about regulatory capture and institutional memory.

articles.title: Vinay Prasad Unloads: 'Fauci Was Wrong About Almost Every Single Pandemic Policy He Advanced'
articles.summary: Former FDA insider and epidemiologist Vinay Prasad tells Reason magazine that Anthony Fauci was wrong on nearly every major COVID-19 policy call — from lockdowns to masking to school closures. Prasad indicts the entire public health apparatus as fundamentally broken, captured, and unaccountable. This is a credentialed insider confirming what independent scientists were censored for saying in 2020.

articles.title: Brownstone Institute Asks the Question Big Media Won't: Why Weren't We Warned?
articles.summary: The Brownstone Institute publishes a damning accountability piece demanding to know why the public was never warned about the known harms of pandemic-era interventions — from lockdown consequences to suppressed adverse event data. The piece names the institutional failures that allowed unproven policies to be imposed without informed consent. This is the kind of post-mortem that legacy outlets refuse to run.

articles.title: Mercola: Political Meddling in Medicine Destroyed Institutional Trust — And the Patients Are Paying
articles.summary: A republished deep-dive from Mercola.com documents how politically driven interference in hospital and public health decision-making during COVID shattered patient trust in ways that will take decades to reverse. The piece connects ideological capture of health institutions to measurable declines in care-seeking behavior and public compliance. What the mainstream calls 'misinformation concerns' is actually a rational response to institutional betrayal.

articles.title: Vitamin D Research the Establishment Keeps Sidelining: International Forum Presents What Mainstream Medicine Ignores
articles.summary: The 2024 International Virtual Vitamin D Forum compiled evidence across immune function, bone health, and systemic disease that continues to be systematically underfunded and underemphasized by mainstream clinical guidelines. Decades of data showing vitamin D's broad therapeutic potential have been dismissed while patent-protected drugs receive preferential research dollars. This is nutrition science suppression in plain sight.

articles.title: Texas Children's Hospital Pays $10M, Opens Detransition Clinic After Paxton Settlement — A Whistleblower's Vindication
articles.summary: Texas Children's Hospital has been forced to open a first-of-its-kind detransition clinic and pay $10 million following AG Ken Paxton's historic legal settlement — a direct consequence of a whistleblower who exposed the hospital's concealed gender intervention program. The whistleblower faced retaliation; the hospital faced accountability. This is what happens when institutions are forced to answer for procedures they were quietly running while publicly denying.

articles.title: Glycolysis-Driven Tumor Progression in Liver Cancer: Metabolic Research That Should Be Reshaping Oncology
articles.summary: New research in PLOS ONE identifies ENO2-driven glycolytic activity as a key driver of hepatocellular carcinoma progression, adding to the growing body of evidence supporting metabolic theories of cancer over the conventional gene-mutation-only paradigm. This research validates what metabolic oncology researchers like Thomas Seyfried have argued for years — that cancer is fundamentally a metabolic disease. The question is how long mainstream oncology will continue to ignore it.
